summary.headline: Astrology and Geomancy Contents
summary.text: Astrological excerpts on Egyptian terms, length of life, monomoiria, planetary sect, quadrants, lunar effects, signs, and winds, followed by a mutilated treatise on geomancy with chapters on ways, gathering, company, pillars, casting away, and useful days of the twelve months. Later additions include a vessel-capacity calculation, psalter divination, apokrupha, and other excerpts.
